path_redaction_note: Machine-specific paths have been sanitized: checkout paths are repo-relative; /example/artifacts/location-N and /example/toolchain are fictional locations scoped to this record. Measurements, revisions, and recorded hashes are unchanged.
baseline_changes: Only identical examples/cursor_traversal.rs and examples/cursor_traversal/fixture.rs copied into an isolated archive and built with its own target directory. All baseline engine sources checked against git, and both fixture copies checked byte-for-byte before measurement.
updated_engine: Working-tree indexed neighbor loading for constrained incremental Rust trail cursors; eager and unconstrained source retained
method: Three sequential fresh-process trials per engine, unrelated-edge count and consumption mode; release builds. Engine order alternates and mode order rotates between trials. All builds/tests finished before measurements. Each process builds a fresh in-memory graph. Query timing includes planning, snapshot setup, decoding, validation and cleanup, excludes fixture setup. First-row latency is time until the first owned row reaches the consumer. Peak RSS and elapsed wall time cover the entire child process, including graph setup. Initial baseline smoke measurements excluded.
fixture: Fixed depth-10 chain with two parallel NEXT relationships per hop: 11 reachable nodes, 20 reachable edges, 2046 paths. Add 0/1000/10000 disconnected nodes with one eligible NEXT self-loop each. Query returns length(p) and endpoint ID; full consumption verifies exact per-depth multiplicity 2^d; first mode verifies one one-hop result. Options allow 1000000 explored states and 1 GiB cumulative payload, retaining default memory limit. Scalar projections; no path hydration.
